# Vitreon Legal

> AI-powered legal research platform providing source-grounded answers from Czech, DIFC, UK, and Australian statutes and court decisions.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://vitreon.app): Legal AI research platform with source-grounded answers, document drafting, and multi-jurisdiction support.
- [Privacy Policy](https://vitreon.app/privacy): GDPR-compliant privacy policy, data controller in Prague, Czech Republic.
- [Terms of Service](https://vitreon.app/terms): Service terms governed by Czech law and Czech courts.

## Key Facts

- Founded in 2025 by Viacheslav Ivannikov
- Headquartered in Prague, Czech Republic
- Jurisdictions: Czech Republic, DIFC (Dubai), United Kingdom, Australia
- GaRAGe benchmark: 0.824 RAF (+36% above published SOTA of 0.607, per ACL 2025)
- LEXam Open EN: 0.691 (+21% above Claude 3.7-S baseline of 0.572, per ICLR 2026)
- ARLC 2026 competition: 4th place out of 80 teams ($32K prize pool, Dubai AI Week)
- 9 Czech legal document templates with statutory grounding
- 100% citation accuracy — every answer cites exact page and clause
- Pricing: Free ($0, 3/day), Starter ($29/mo), Pro ($179/mo), Enterprise ($499/mo)
- Stack: FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, PostgreSQL + pgvector, custom-trained embeddings
